ValidationRule.description: Venkat: Created as part of NZC Phase 3 Implementation. Purpose: Restrict the Data Modeller to edit the Approved System Generated Energy Use Records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( $User.User_Type__c ,"Data Modeller"), IsSystemGeneratedRecord = TRUE, ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Approved") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You Cannot Edit the record once it is approved.
